subject: Application: Utilities Engineer, Civil Infrastructure, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Utilities Engineer, Civil Infrastructure advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Part of that work was lodging Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designing around existing services and site constraints. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, carrying out inspections and coordinating with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert mentions reviewing BYDA information and civil designs for utility conflicts, which builds on the service checks I did in my course. I have not worked as a utilities engineer yet, so I would start at entry level, and I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short call about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Graduate civil drafter enquiry for your Melbourne team, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your careers page says AT&L is growing in Melbourne and asks civil drafters and designers to send a CV and cover letter to this address, so I am asking about any graduate civil drafter or junior civil designer role in your Melbourne team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office and site work.

Your Amaroo Business Park work in Craigieburn, with roads, stormwater, earthworks and retaining walls, is the kind of civil documentation I want to learn on. My drafting so far is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a graduate drafting or design role in Melbourne?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
